exposure: time points (before delivery, within 24h after delivery)
outcome: middle cerebral artery (MCA) blood flow velocity parameters (mean cerebral blood flow velocity, peak systolic velocity, pulsatility index, resistance index, systolic/diastolic ratio)
cohort: The study included 35 healthy pregnant women with a gestational age of >37 weeks who were in labor and a control group of 24 healthy, age-matched, nonpregnant women.
finding: Maternal MCA blood flow velocity decreased during late pregnancy and increased in the early postpartum period to levels similar to nonpregnant women.
